name: Supplier TIN missing
msg: AccountingSupplierParty has no PartyIdentification with schemeID "TIN". IRBM rejects the submission before any field is read.
fix: Add PartyIdentification ID schemeID="TIN" with the supplier's LHDN Tax Identification Number.

name: Supplier TIN shape is not an IRBM TIN
msg: Supplier TIN "{v}" is not one or two letters followed by 9-12 digits (e.g. C25845632100, IG56003500070).
fix: Copy the TIN from MyTax exactly: no spaces, no dashes, keep the C / IG / CS prefix.

name: General public TIN used as the supplier
msg: TIN EI00000000010 is the general public TIN. It is a buyer-side value for consolidated and foreign-buyer e-Invoices; a supplier must submit under its own TIN.
fix: Put your own TIN in AccountingSupplierParty and keep EI00000000010 only in AccountingCustomerParty.

name: MSIC code is not 5 digits
msg: IndustryClassificationCode "{v}" is not a 5-digit MSIC 2008 code.
fix: Use the 5-digit MSIC code shown on your LHDN profile, e.g. 62010 for computer programming activities.

name: MSIC business activity description empty
msg: IndustryClassificationCode carries no name attribute, so the business activity description is blank.
fix: Add name="<business activity description>" next to the MSIC code.

name: Supplier telephone missing or too short
msg: Supplier Contact Telephone is "{v}". IRBM expects a reachable number in E.164 form.
fix: Write the phone as +60XXXXXXXXX with no spaces.

name: Buyer has no registration identifier
msg: AccountingCustomerParty carries a TIN but no BRN, NRIC, PASSPORT or ARMY identifier. IRBM validates the TIN against that second identifier.
fix: Add a second PartyIdentification with schemeID BRN, NRIC, PASSPORT or ARMY.

name: e-Invoice type code is not an IRBM code
msg: InvoiceTypeCode "{v}" is not an IRBM e-Invoice type code.
fix: Use 01 Invoice, 02 Credit Note, 03 Debit Note, 04 Refund Note, 11 Self-billed Invoice, 12 Self-billed Credit Note, 13 Self-billed Debit Note, 14 Self-billed Refund Note.

name: e-Invoice version not declared
msg: InvoiceTypeCode listVersionID is "{v}"; IRBM accepts 1.0 (unsigned) or 1.1 (signed).
fix: Set listVersionID="1.1" and sign the document, or "1.0" for the unsigned schema.

name: Document currency is not an ISO 4217 code
msg: DocumentCurrencyCode "{v}" is not three capital letters.
fix: Use the ISO 4217 alphabetic code, e.g. MYR, USD, SGD.

name: Foreign currency without an exchange rate
msg: Document currency is {v} but TaxExchangeRate CalculationRate is missing or zero. A non-MYR e-Invoice must also carry the MYR rate.
fix: Add TaxExchangeRate with SourceCurrencyCode {v}, TargetCurrencyCode MYR and the CalculationRate used.

name: Line classification code is not an IRBM class
msg: Line {v}: ItemClassificationCode is missing or not a 3-digit IRBM classification code in the 001-045 range.
fix: Add CommodityClassification ItemClassificationCode listID="CLASS" with a padded 3-digit code, e.g. 022 for others.

name: Tax type code is not an IRBM tax type
msg: Line {v}: TaxCategory ID is not an IRBM tax type code.
fix: Use 01 Sales Tax, 02 Service Tax, 03 Tourism Tax, 04 High-Value Goods Tax, 05 Sales Tax on Low Value Goods, 06 Not Applicable, E Tax exemption.

name: Credit, debit or refund note with no original reference
msg: e-Invoice type {v} must point at the original e-Invoice, but BillingReference carries no reference number.
fix: Add BillingReference AdditionalDocumentReference ID with the original e-Invoice internal ID or UUID.

name: Version 1.1 document is not signed
msg: listVersionID is 1.1 but the document has no UBLExtensions signature block.
fix: Sign with version 1.1, or drop to listVersionID "1.0" if you submit unsigned.
